bio.text: Blanca Pacheco was elected in 2022 to represent California's 64th Assembly District, which covers parts of southeastern Los Angeles County and northern Orange County. She chairs the Assembly Rules Committee.
Before the Assembly she served two terms as mayor of Downey, the first Latina elected to that position, after being elected to the Downey City Council in 2016 and becoming mayor in 2020.
She received a bachelor's degree in political science from UCLA in 1998, attended Loyola Law School, and has been an attorney since 2003.
